art_direction: 墨黑绿瞳 · 狡黠一瞥: 墨黑底，翡翠绿细弯眼，向侧面瞟的狡黠神态。
composition_variation: Uniform matte near-black field. Saturated jade-green narrow iris crescents beneath heavy black half-lids merging into background. Amused clever sideways glance: both pupils look hard right; left eye a wider horizontal almond, right slimmer and slightly higher. Green lower rims vary in thickness like hand-cut paper. Single small ivory slit highlight per pupil. Teasing and friendly, not angry or threatening. No mouth, nose or eyebrows. Eye pair just above mid-height, ample empty space below.
style_inspiration: Two user-provided chat attachments were observed for broad style: minimalist eyes, black or ivory field, sparse color, handmade matte edges. Original expressions and layouts were described in text. No attachment was uploaded as binary model input and no watermark-removal edit was performed.
